answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 20606 Country: India Title: is the business of buying of bank recovered cars and flats ( property ) by the means of bank auctions is haraam or halaal. is the courier business for banks and insurance companies haraam or halaal. Question: is the business of buying of bank recovered cars and flats ( property ) by the means of bank auctions is haraam or halaal. is the courier business for banks and insurance companies haraam or halaal. thanks for ur reply. Answer ID: 20606 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 407/327/B=1431) (1) One should avoid purchasing bank car through auctions. (2) If you want to send courier from your side you can. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
